items.source: invocation - the MethodInvocation being traced
items.translation: invocation - 正在跟踪的 MethodInvocation

items.source: logger - the Log instance to check
items.translation: logger - 要检查的 Log 实例

items.source: To be called by invokeUnderTrace(MethodInvocation, Log) for enter/exit outcomes, potentially including an exception. Note that an exception's stack trace won't get logged when setLogExceptionStackTrace(boolean) is "false".
items.translation: 由 `invokeUnderTrace(MethodInvocation, Log)` 调用，用于进入/退出结果，可能包含异常。请注意，当 `setLogExceptionStackTrace(boolean)` 为 "false" 时，异常的堆栈跟踪将不会被记录。

items.source: By default, log messages are written to the log for the interceptor class, not the class which is being intercepted. Setting the useDynamicLogger bean property to true causes all log messages to be written to the Log for the target class being intercepted.
items.translation: 默认情况下，日志消息写入拦截器类的日志，而不是被拦截的类的日志。将 `useDynamicLogger` bean 属性设置为 `true` 会导致所有日志消息写入被拦截的目标类的 `Log`。

items.source: Used to determine which Log instance should be used to write log messages for a particular method invocation: a dynamic one for the Class getting called, or a static one for the Class of the trace interceptor.
items.translation: 用于确定应使用哪个 `Log` 实例来写入特定方法调用的日志消息：是用于被调用 `Class` 的动态实例，还是用于跟踪拦截器 `Class` 的静态实例。

items.source: By default messages are written at TRACE level. Subclasses can override this method to control which level the message is written at, typically also overriding isLogEnabled(Log) accordingly.
items.translation: 默认情况下，消息以 `TRACE` 级别写入。子类可以重写此方法以控制消息的写入级别，通常也会相应地重写 isLogEnabled(Log)。

items.source: By default, the passed-in Log instance will have log level "trace" enabled. Subclasses do not have to check for this again, unless they overwrite the isInterceptorEnabled method to modify the default behavior, and may delegate to writeToLog for actual messages to be written.
items.translation: 默认情况下，传入的 `Log` 实例将启用 "trace" 日志级别。子类无需再次检查此设置，除非它们重写 `isInterceptorEnabled` 方法来修改默认行为；否则，可以将实际消息写入委托给 `writeToLog` 方法。

items.source: Subclasses must implement the invokeUnderTrace method, which is invoked by this class ONLY when a particular invocation SHOULD be traced. Subclasses should write to the Log instance provided.
items.translation: 子类必须实现 `invokeUnderTrace` 方法，该方法仅当特定调用应该被追踪时由本类调用。子类应写入提供的 `Log` 实例。

items.source: To be called by invokeUnderTrace(MethodInvocation, Log) for enter/exit messages.
items.translation: 由 `invokeUnderTrace(MethodInvocation, Log)` 调用，用于进入/退出消息。

items.source: Delegates to writeToLog(Log, String, Throwable) as the ultimate delegate that controls the underlying logger invocation.
items.translation: 委托给作为控制底层日志器调用的最终委托的writeToLog(Log, String, Throwable)。

items.source: NOTE: Specify either this property or "loggerName", not both.
items.translation: 注意： 请指定此属性或"loggerName"，但不要同时指定两者。

items.source: NOTE: Specify either this property or "useDynamicLogger", not both.
items.translation: 注意：请指定此属性或"useDynamicLogger"，但不要同时指定两者。

items.source: Default behavior is to check whether the given Log instance is enabled. Subclasses can override this to apply the interceptor in other cases as well.
items.translation: 默认行为是检查给定的Log实例是否已启用。子类可以重写此方法，以便在其他情况下也应用拦截器。

items.source: Default is true when the "trace" level is enabled. Subclasses can override this to change the level under which 'tracing' occurs.
items.translation: 默认情况下，当启用"trace"级别时，该值为 `true`。子类可以重写此方法以更改发生“跟踪”的级别。

items.source:
This can be specified to not log into the category of a class
(whether this interceptor's class or the class getting called)
but rather into a specific named category.
items.translation: 这可以指定不记录到类的类别（无论是该拦截器的类还是被调用的类），而是记录到特定的命名类别中。

items.source: Return the appropriate Log instance to use for the given MethodInvocation. If the useDynamicLogger flag is set, the Log instance will be for the target class of the MethodInvocation, otherwise the Log will be the default static logger.
items.translation: 返回用于给定 `<code>MethodInvocation` 的适当 `<code>Log` 实例。如果设置了 `<code>useDynamicLogger` 标志，则 `<code>Log` 实例将针对 `<code>MethodInvocation` 的目标类；否则，`<code>Log` 将是默认静态记录器。

items.source: Set to "true" to have dynamic loggers hide proxy class names wherever possible.
items.translation: 设置为"true"以使动态日志记录器尽可能隐藏代理类名称。

items.source: The default Log instance used to write trace messages. This instance is mapped to the implementing Class.
items.translation: 用于写入跟踪消息的默认 `Log` 实例。 该实例映射到实现类 `Class`。

items.source: Set to "true" to have dynamic loggers hide proxy class names wherever possible. Default is "false".
items.translation: 设置为"true"可使动态日志记录器尽可能隐藏代理类名称。默认值为"false"。

items.source: Determines whether logging is enabled for the particular MethodInvocation. If not, the method invocation proceeds as normal, otherwise the method invocation is passed to the invokeUnderTrace method for handling.
items.translation: 确定是否已为特定的MethodInvocation启用日志记录。如果未启用，则方法调用按正常方式继续；否则，将方法调用传递给invokeUnderTrace方法进行处理。

items.source: Determine the class to use for logging purposes.
items.translation: 确定用于日志记录的类。

items.source:
Set whether to pass an exception to the logger, suggesting inclusion
of its stack trace into the log. Default is "true"; set this to "false"
in order to reduce the log output to just the trace message (which may
include the exception class name and exception message, if applicable).
items.translation: 设置是否将异常传递给记录器，建议将其堆栈跟踪包含在日志中。默认值为 "true"；将其设置为 "false" 可将日志输出减少为仅包含跟踪消息（如果适用，该消息可能包括异常类名和异常消息）。

items.source:
• setUseDynamicLogger(boolean)
  • invokeUnderTrace(org.aopalliance.intercept.MethodInvocation, org.apache.commons.logging.Log)
  • Serialized Form
items.translation:

items.source: Throwable - if the call to MethodInvocation.proceed() encountered any errors
items.translation: Throwable - 如果调用 MethodInvocation.proceed() 遇到任何错误

items.source: logger - the Log to write trace messages to
items.translation: logger - 用于写入跟踪消息的 Log

items.source: the Log instance to use
items.translation: 要使用的Log实例

items.source: target - the target object to introspect
items.translation: target - 要检查的对象

items.source: the result of the call to MethodInvocation.proceed()
items.translation: 对 `MethodInvocation.proceed()` 调用的结果

items.source: the target class for the given object
items.translation: 给定对象的目标类

items.source: Write the supplied trace message and Throwable to the supplied Log instance.
items.translation: 将提供的跟踪消息和Throwable写入提供的Log实例。

items.source: Return the appropriate Log instance to use for the given MethodInvocation.
items.translation: 返回用于给定MethodInvocation的适当Log实例。

items.source: The default Log instance used to write trace messages.
items.translation: 用于写入跟踪消息的默认Log实例。

items.source: Determines whether logging is enabled for the particular MethodInvocation.
items.translation: 确定是否已为特定的MethodInvocation启用日志记录。

items.source: Subclasses must override this method to perform any tracing around the supplied MethodInvocation.
items.translation: 子类必须重写此方法，以执行对提供的 `<code>MethodInvocation` 的跟踪。

items.source: Determine whether the interceptor should kick in, that is, whether the invokeUnderTrace method should be called.
items.translation: 确定拦截器是否应该介入，即，是否应调用 `invokeUnderTrace` 方法。

items.source: Determine whether the given Log instance is enabled.
items.translation: 确定给定的Log实例是否已启用。

items.source: Write the supplied trace message to the supplied Log instance.
items.translation: 将提供的跟踪消息写入提供的Log实例。

items.source:
Set whether to pass an exception to the logger, suggesting inclusion
of its stack trace into the log.
items.translation: 设置是否将异常传递给记录器，建议将其堆栈跟踪包含在日志中。

items.source: Set the name of the logger to use.
items.translation: 设置要使用的日志记录器名称。

items.source: Set whether to use a dynamic logger or a static logger.
items.translation: 设置是使用动态日志记录器还是静态日志记录器。

items.source: invoke in interface MethodInterceptor
items.translation: `invoke` 在接口 `MethodInterceptor` 中

items.source: the result of the call to Joinpoint.proceed(); might be intercepted by the interceptor
items.translation: 调用Joinpoint.proceed()的结果；可能会被拦截器拦截。

items.source: Throwable - if the interceptors or the target object throws an exception
items.translation: Throwable - 如果拦截器或目标对象抛出异常

items.source: invocation - the method invocation joinpoint
items.translation: invocation - 方法调用连接点
